packageRules.description: Patch, pin and digest updates merge on their own once CI is green.
Cadenway packages are proposed as soon as they are published.
The Tiptap packages pin each other to one exact version: they are updated together.
@angular/aria requires @angular/cdk at its own exact version: they are updated together.
TypeScript stays on 6.0 until Angular (compiler-cli, build, ng-packagr) accepts a newer line.
